name: Glenhoff Brauhaus
description_short: German-style brewpub in Hartenbos serving hearty grills, craft beers, and pub favourites with a relaxed vibe.
description_long:
Glenhoff Brauhaus brings a taste of Bavaria to the Garden Route, combining the warmth of a traditional German brauhaus with South African hospitality. Located along the R102 in Hartenbos, this casual pub and grill offers a menu of hearty favourites—think flame-grilled steaks, loaded burgers, and satisfying pub platters—best enjoyed with a cold craft beer or two.

The atmosphere is laid-back and welcoming, making it a solid choice for families, groups, or anyone looking for unpretentious comfort food in a relaxed setting. Whether you're stopping in after a day at the beach or settling in for a sports game at the bar, Glenhoff Brauhaus delivers straightforward, honest fare without fuss. The outdoor seating adds to the easygoing charm, especially on warm Garden Route evenings.
